{#- The page: a bh-01 app frame built from bh-01's own components (docs/theme/vendor/bh-01). lays it out: an activity bar of the top-level sections, a sidebar panel holding each section's pages as a (one shown at a time), the page in a
landmark, and a status bar with the build's branch and commit, Search and the theme toggle. The command palette searches MkDocs' own search index. assets/bh-docs.js wires it up. -#} {%- set icons = {"Home": "home", "bh-02": "terminal", "cordis": "blocks", "brig": "lock", "warden": "pulse", "Contributing": "pencil"} -%} {%- macro view_id(item) -%}{{ item.title | lower | replace(" ", "-") }}{%- endmacro -%} {%- macro section_of(item) -%}{%- if item.parent -%}{{ section_of(item.parent) }}{%- else -%}{{ item.title }}{%- endif -%}{%- endmacro -%} {%- macro tree_items(items, depth, prefix, nested) -%} {%- for item in items -%} {%- if item.children -%} {{- tree_items(item.children, depth + 1, prefix ~ loop.index ~ ".", true) -}} {%- elif item.is_page -%} {%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- endmacro -%} {%- set current = nav.items | selectattr("active") | first -%} {%- macro view_label(item) -%}{{ "Contents" if item.is_page else item.title }}{%- endmacro -%} {%- set pages = namespace(items=[]) -%} {%- for item in nav.pages -%} {%- set _ = pages.items.append({"url": item.url, "title": item.title, "section": section_of(item) | trim}) -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- if config.site_description %} {%- endif %} {% if page.title and not page.is_homepage %}{{ page.title | striptags | e }} - {% endif %}{{ config.site_name | e }} Skip to content {%- for item in nav.items %} {%- endfor %} {%- for item in nav.items %} {%- if item.is_page %} {{ tree_items(nav.items | rejectattr("is_homepage") | list, 0, "all.", false) }} {%- else %} {{ tree_items(item.children, 0, view_id(item) ~ ".", false) }} {%- endif %} {%- endfor %}
